stories.title: Private investors put $15B into nuclear reactors in Oak Ridge, say it could create 10K jobs
stories.summary: Energy representatives said an increase in reactors could eliminate the need for diesel generators.

stories.title: Downtown Maryville hotel scrapped mid-build
stories.summary: Maryville's plan for a downtown hotel halts as soil issues and financial constraints stall progress. The city said it will soon seek new developers.

stories.title: City Council approves Mayor Kincannon's request to invest $70M in Knoxville Civic Auditorium and Convention Center
stories.summary: City officials said the investment will extend the life of both venues "well past another three decades."

stories.title: Pigeon Forge's 'Country Tonite Theatre' to close after 30 seasons; owner cites leadership changes
stories.summary: In an announcement on Saturday, leaders said they decided to conclude operations at the end of the year rather than transition to new management.

stories.title: 2016 Gatlinburg wildfire survivor looks back while visiting memorial
stories.summary: A Gathering of Remembrance for wildfire victims is planned for Saturday at 10 a.m. at Mynatt Park.

stories.title: CCSO: No injuries reported after school bus crash in Newport
stories.summary: The Cocke County Sheriff's Office said a replacement school bus came to pick up the children and take them to their homes.

stories.title: New Oak Ridge supercomputer could turn years of scientific research into months
stories.summary: Oak Ridge National Laboratory's new supercomputer, Lux, combines artificial intelligence with supercomputing to help scientists speed up research.

stories.title: Knox County woman resolves claim against KCSO for $165K
stories.summary: Donna Dillon filed suit in 2025 after deputies showed up at her door with a warrant as they were filmed by the show "On Patrol: Live."

stories.title: Knox Area Transit will be closed on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: KAT said there will be no fixed-route or LIFT service on Nov. 26. Services will operate on a Sunday schedule on Nov. 27.

stories.title: Jefferson City police searching for Carson-Newman student missing since Saturday
stories.summary: The Jefferson City Police Department said Sean Mitchell Simmons, 19, was last seen at the CNU West Campus Commons on Nov. 21 around 5 a.m.

stories.title: Knoxville churches explore partnerships to keep historic buildings open amid financial struggles
stories.summary: Amid a national trend of church closures, some Knoxville area churches are seeking community partners to help keep their doors open.

stories.title: Knox Co. Sheriff's Office lawsuit payouts total $4.58M since 2016
stories.summary: KCSO claim payouts total $4.58M since 2016 Three payments account for more than half the $4.58 million in claims tied to the Knox County Sheriff’s Office since 2016.
